# cubepath_nat_gateway (Resource)

Manages a NAT gateway on CubePath Cloud.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the NAT gateway.
- `network_id` (Number) The private network ID to attach the NAT gateway to. Requires replacement if changed.
- `plan_name` (String) The plan name (e.g., nat.small). Changing this resizes the NAT gateway in-place.

### Optional

- `label` (String) Optional label for the NAT gateway.
- `project_id` (Number) The project ID. Uses default project if not specified. Changing it moves the NAT gateway in place.
- `protected` (Boolean) Deletion protection. A protected NAT gateway cannot be destroyed until this is set to false. If omitted, the current setting is kept.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the NAT gateway was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the NAT gateway.
- `location_name` (String) The location where the NAT gateway is deployed.
- `status` (String) Current status of the NAT gateway.
